body.heading: Where in the world is Vanuatu?
paragraphs: Vanuatu is a country in Melanesia, which is part of Oceania. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Vanuatu is Port Vila.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Vanuatu speak Bislama, English and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Vanuatu is the Vanuatu vatu.

body.heading: How big is Vanuatu?
paragraphs: Vanuatu covers about 12,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Mount Yasur is one of the world's most accessible active volcanoes — families can stand at its rim at dusk and watch it hurl glowing lava into the sky.
Santo's blue holes are freshwater springs of impossible sapphire blue, with rope swings and jungle shade — plus Champagne Beach's white sand nearby.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Vanuatu on a map or globe. Which continent is it nearest to — and what sea or ocean surrounds it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
